name: Skate Macros

instructions: Press the configured hotkey in-game to execute.
code:
#NoEnv
#SingleInstance Force
SendMode Input
SetWorkingDir %A_ScriptDir%
#IfWinActive ahk_exe destiny2.exe

; ==============================================================================
; Destiny 2 - Complete Skate Suite by Awoke (Running / Sprint Compatible)
; Press F8 anytime to open the Configuration Menu
; ==============================================================================

IniFile := A_ScriptDir . "\settings.ini"

; --- 1. Load Skate Triggers ---
IniRead, Key_WarlockLedge,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockLedge,  F5
IniRead, Key_WarlockGround, %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockGround, F6
IniRead, Key_HunterLedge,   %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterLedge,   XButton1
IniRead, Key_HunterGround,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterGround,  F9
IniRead, Key_HunterStrand,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterStrand,  F10

; --- 2. Load In-Game Keybinds ---
IniRead, HeavySwing,   %IniFile%, Keybinds, HeavySwing,   LButton
IniRead, LightSwing,   %IniFile%, Keybinds, LightSwing,   f
IniRead, BlockKey,     %IniFile%, Keybinds, BlockKey,     RButton
IniRead, Super,        %IniFile%, Keybinds, Super,        6
IniRead, AirMove,      %IniFile%, Keybinds, AirMove,      x
IniRead, Slide,        %IniFile%, Keybinds, Slide,        Ctrl
IniRead, Sprint,       %IniFile%, Keybinds, Sprint,       Shift

; --- 3. Load Timing ---
IniRead, HeavyHoldTime, %IniFile%, Timings, HeavyHoldTime, 20

; Global recording state
GlobalCapturedKey := ""
GlobalActiveControl := ""

; Register Hotkeys
gosub, ApplyHotkeys
return

; ==============================================================================
; HOTKEY BINDING & PARSER (WILDCARD SPRINT SUPPORT)
; ==============================================================================
ParseAhkHotkey(str) {
    str := Trim(str)
    if (str = "" || str = "None" || str = "[ Press Key... ]")
        return ""
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM3\b", "MButton")
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM4\b", "XButton1")
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM5\b", "XButton2")
    
    mod := ""
    while RegExMatch(str, "i)^(Ctrl\+|Shift\+|Alt\+)") {
        if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Ctrl\+") {
            mod .= "^"
            str := SubStr(str, 6)
        } else if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Shift\+") {
            mod .= "+"
            str := SubStr(str, 7)
        } else if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Alt\+") {
            mod .= "!"
            str := SubStr(str, 5)
        }
    }
    ; Wildcard '*' allows the hotkey to fire while holding Shift (running) or other keys
    return "*" . mod . str
}

ApplyHotkeys:
    ; Unbind previous
    if (OldWL)
        Hotkey, %OldWL%, ExecWarlockLedge, Off, UseErrorLevel
    if (OldWG)
        Hotkey, %OldWG%, ExecWarlockGround, Off, UseErrorLevel
    if (OldHL)
        Hotkey, %OldHL%, ExecHunterLedge, Off, UseErrorLevel
    if (OldHG)
        Hotkey, %OldHG%, ExecHunterGround, Off, UseErrorLevel
    if (OldHS)
        Hotkey, %OldHS%, ExecHunterStrand, Off, UseErrorLevel

    ; Parse and bind new hotkeys with wildcard
    ActiveWL := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_WarlockLedge)
    ActiveWG := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_WarlockGround)
    ActiveHL := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_HunterLedge)
    ActiveHG := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_HunterGround)
    ActiveHS := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_HunterStrand)

    if (ActiveWL != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveWL%, ExecWarlockLedge, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldWL := ActiveWL
    }
    if (ActiveWG != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveWG%, ExecWarlockGround, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldWG := ActiveWG
    }
    if (ActiveHL != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveHL%, ExecHunterLedge, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldHL := ActiveHL
    }
    if (ActiveHG != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveHG%, ExecHunterGround, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldHG := ActiveHG
    }
    if (ActiveHS != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveHS%, ExecHunterStrand, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldHS := ActiveHS
    }
return

; ==============================================================================
; CLICK-TO-PRESS CAPTURE ENGINE WITH AUTO-DESELECT
; ==============================================================================
OnKeyBoxClick:
    CtrlName := A_GuiControl
    GlobalActiveControl := CtrlName
    GlobalCapturedKey := ""
    
    GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, [ Press Key... ]
    
    ; Setup mouse button traps
    fnMouse := Func("OnMouseCaptured")
    Hotkey, IfWinActive, Destiny 2 Skate Suite - Control Panel
    Hotkey, *MButton, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *XButton1, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *XButton2, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *RButton, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *WheelUp, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *WheelDown, %fnMouse%, On
    
    ih := InputHook("V L1 T6", "{LControl}{RControl}{LAlt}{RAlt}{LShift}{RShift}{LWin}{RWin}{AppsKey}{F1}{F2}{F3}{F4}{F5}{F6}{F7}{F8}{F9}{F10}{F11}{F12}{Left}{Right}{Up}{Down}{Home}{End}{PgUp}{PgDn}{Del}{Ins}{BS}{Capslock}{Numlock}{PrintScreen}{Pause}{Tab}{Enter}{Space}{Esc}")
    
    Loop {
        ih.Start()
        ih.Wait()
        
        ; If mouse button was clicked
        if (GlobalCapturedKey != "") {
            GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, %GlobalCapturedKey%
            break
        }
        
        ; Escape cancels capture
        if (ih.EndKey = "Esc") {
            GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, % GetOriginalVal(CtrlName)
            break
        }
        
        k := (ih.EndKey != "") ? ih.EndKey : ih.Input
        if (k = "")
            continue
            
        ; If user pressed a modifier alone, check if they are holding it for a combo
        isMod := RegExMatch(k, "i)^(LControl|RControl|LAlt|RAlt|LShift|RShift|LWin|RWin|Control|Alt|Shift)$")
        if (isMod) {
            Sleep, 180
            if (!GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P") && !GetKeyState("Shift", "P") && !GetKeyState("Alt", "P")) {
                cleanMod := RegExReplace(k, "^[LR]", "")
                GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, %cleanMod%
                break
            }
            continue
        }
        
        ; Build modifier combo
        mods := ""
        if GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P")
            mods .= "Ctrl+"
        if GetKeyState("Shift", "P")
            mods .= "Shift+"
        if GetKeyState("Alt", "P")
            mods .= "Alt+"
            
        if (StrLen(k) = 1)
            k := Format("{:U}", k)
        else
            k := RegExReplace(k, "^[LR]", "")
            
        GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, % mods . k
        break
    }
    
    ; Turn off mouse traps
    Hotkey, *MButton, Off
    Hotkey, *XButton1, Off
    Hotkey, *XButton2, Off
    Hotkey, *RButton, Off
    Hotkey, *WheelUp, Off
    Hotkey, *WheelDown, Off
    Hotkey, IfWinActive
    
    ; Auto-deselect: shift focus away to dummy
    GuiControl, Focus, DummyHiddenBtn
return

OnMouseCaptured() {
    global GlobalCapturedKey
    btn := SubStr(A_ThisHotkey, 2)
    mods := ""
    if GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P")
        mods .= "Ctrl+"
    if GetKeyState("Shift", "P")
        mods .= "Shift+"
    if GetKeyState("Alt", "P")
        mods .= "Alt+"
        
    GlobalCapturedKey := mods . btn
}

GetOriginalVal(ctrl) {
    global
    if (ctrl = "BoxWL") return Key_WarlockLedge
    if (ctrl = "BoxWG") return Key_WarlockGround
    if (ctrl = "BoxHL") return Key_HunterLedge
    if (ctrl = "BoxHG") return Key_HunterGround
    if (ctrl = "BoxHS") return Key_HunterStrand
    if (ctrl = "BoxHeavy") return HeavySwing
    if (ctrl = "BoxLight") return LightSwing
    if (ctrl = "BoxBlock") return BlockKey
    if (ctrl = "BoxSuper") return Super
    if (ctrl = "BoxAir")   return AirMove
    if (ctrl = "BoxSlide") return Slide
    if (ctrl = "BoxSprint")return Sprint
    return "None"
}

; ==============================================================================
; RESET DEFAULTS & SAVE
; ==============================================================================
ResetDefaults:

    GuiControl,, BoxWG, F6
    GuiControl,, BoxHL, XButton1
    GuiControl,, BoxHG, F9
    GuiControl,, BoxHS, F10
    
    GuiControl,, BoxHeavy, LButton
    GuiControl,, BoxLight, f
    GuiControl,, BoxBlock, RButton
    GuiControl,, BoxSuper, 6
    GuiControl,, BoxAir, x
    GuiControl,, BoxSlide, Ctrl
    GuiControl,, BoxSprint, Shift
    GuiControl,, NewHold, 20
return

SaveSettings:
    Gui, Submit, NoHide
    
    ; Retrieve values from box texts
    GuiControlGet, vWL,, BoxWL
    GuiControlGet, vWG,, BoxWG
    GuiControlGet, vHL,, BoxHL
    GuiControlGet, vHG,, BoxHG
    GuiControlGet, vHS,, BoxHS
    
    GuiControlGet, vHeavy,, BoxHeavy
    GuiControlGet, vLight,, BoxLight
    GuiControlGet, vBlock,, BoxBlock
    GuiControlGet, vSuper,, BoxSuper
    GuiControlGet, vAir,,   BoxAir
    GuiControlGet, vSlide,, BoxSlide
    GuiControlGet, vSprint,,BoxSprint
    GuiControlGet, vHold,,  NewHold
    
    Key_WarlockLedge  := (vWL != "" && vWL != "[ Press Key... ]") ? vWL : Key_WarlockLedge
    Key_WarlockGround := (vWG != "" && vWG != "[ Press Key... ]") ? vWG : Key_WarlockGround
    Key_HunterLedge   := (vHL != "" && vHL != "[ Press Key... ]") ? vHL : Key_HunterLedge
    Key_HunterGround  := (vHG != "" && vHG != "[ Press Key... ]") ? vHG : Key_HunterGround
    Key_HunterStrand  := (vHS != "" && vHS != "[ Press Key... ]") ? vHS : Key_HunterStrand
    
    HeavySwing    := (vHeavy != "" && vHeavy != "[ Press Key... ]")   ? vHeavy  : HeavySwing
    LightSwing    := (vLight != "" && vLight != "[ Press Key... ]")   ? vLight  : LightSwing
    BlockKey      := (vBlock != "" && vBlock != "[ Press Key... ]")   ? vBlock  : BlockKey
    Super         := (vSuper != "" && vSuper != "[ Press Key... ]")   ? vSuper  : Super
    AirMove       := (vAir != ""   && vAir != "[ Press Key... ]")     ? vAir    : AirMove
    Slide         := (vSlide != "" && vSlide != "[ Press Key... ]")   ? vSlide  : Slide
    Sprint        := (vSprint != ""&& vSprint != "[ Press Key... ]")  ? vSprint : Sprint
    HeavyHoldTime := (vHold != "") ? vHold : 20
    
    ; Save to settings.ini
    IniWrite, %Key_WarlockLedge%,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockLedge
    IniWrite, %Key_WarlockGround%, %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockGround
    IniWrite, %Key_HunterLedge%,   %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterLedge
    IniWrite, %Key_HunterGround%,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterGround
    IniWrite, %Key_HunterStrand%,  %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterStrand
    
    IniWrite, %HeavySwing%,    %IniFile%, Keybinds, HeavySwing
    IniWrite, %LightSwing%,    %IniFile%, Keybinds, LightSwing
    IniWrite, %BlockKey%,      %IniFile%, Keybinds, BlockKey
    IniWrite, %Super%,         %IniFile%, Keybinds, Super
    IniWrite, %AirMove%,       %IniFile%, Keybinds, AirMove
    IniWrite, %Slide%,         %IniFile%, Keybinds, Slide
    IniWrite, %Sprint%,        %IniFile%, Keybinds, Sprint
    IniWrite, %HeavyHoldTime%, %IniFile%, Timings, HeavyHoldTime
    
    gosub, ApplyHotkeys
    SoundBeep, 800, 150
    Gui, Destroy
return

; ==============================================================================
; MACRO EXECUTION ROUTINES
; ==============================================================================
SendKey(k, state := "") {
    if (k = "" || k = "None")
        return
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM3\b", "MButton")
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM4\b", "XButton1")
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM5\b", "XButton2")
    
    if InStr(k, "Shift+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 7)
        SendInput, {Shift down}{%subKey% %state%}{Shift up}
    } else if InStr(k, "Ctrl+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 6)
        SendInput, {Ctrl down}{%subKey% %state%}{Ctrl up}
    } else if InStr(k, "Alt+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 5)
        SendInput, {Alt down}{%subKey% %state%}{Alt up}
    } else {
        if (state != "")
            SendInput, {%k% %state%}
        else
            SendInput, {%k%}
    }
}

; --- 1. Warlock Ledge Skate ---
ExecWarlockLedge:
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "down")
    Sleep, %HeavyHoldTime%
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 15
    SendKey(Super)
return

; --- 2. Warlock Skate, Flat Ground ---
ExecWarlockGround:
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 40
    SendKey(LightSwing)
    Sleep, 40
    Send {Space}
    SendKey(Super)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return

; --- 3. Hunter Ledge Skate ---
ExecHunterLedge:
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "down")
    Sleep, %HeavyHoldTime%
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 15
    SendKey(AirMove)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return

; --- 4. Hunter Skate, Flat Ground ---
ExecHunterGround:
    SendKey(BlockKey, "down")
    Sleep, 20
    SendKey(BlockKey, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 45
    SendKey(LightSwing)
    Sleep, 30
    Send {Space}
    SendKey(AirMove)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return

; --- 5. Hunter Strand Skate ---
ExecHunterStrand:
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "down")
    Sleep, 20
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "up")
    SendKey(AirMove)
    Sleep, 10
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return
